decision.explanation: All three candidates are directly supported by the original sources. 'TechCorp v. ChipMaster' is cited as a landmark patent infringement lawsuit involving the method in D1S9. 'Oral argument on February 10, 2022' is explicitly stated as the date and nature of the event in D1S8 and elaborated in D1S10–D1S11. 'US Patent 11152372' is identified as the patent describing the method in D1S5 and D2S4. These distinct referents represent separate but related events involving the method and are preserved as valid, non-conflicting answers.
